cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: one anionic route, Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate #2, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #3 and nonionic Cocamide DIPA #4 with Glycerin #5; no second reinforcing anionic or chelating reset route (Disodium EDTA #17 is a stabilizer level). By analogy with C1. Buildup-removal intent cannot assign strength (3.2).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: olefin sulfonate is a high-detergency anionic; 'removes heavy build-up' intent

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - Glycerin #5, PEG-150 Distearate #8, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter #10, Glycol Distearate #13, Panthenol #14, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #15, Polyquaternium-39 #19; lipid and cationics sit after Parfum #9.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: depositionLoad light (late shea #10, two late cationics #15/#19, Polyester-37 #11), persistence low-moderate, resetCapacity moderate (olefin sulfonate). Late lipid and light polymers can remain low.
weightPotential.counterSignal: shea butter is a persistent lipid; 'Cream' architecture
weightPotential.whyThisBand: deposition routes are late and light
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: no meaningfully persistent system at a prominent position

focusPrimary.rationale: Clarifying: 'Cleansing Cream Shampoo' whose lead claims are buildup removal ('removes buildup', 'gently removes heavy build-up from the hair and scalp', 'befreit Haar sowie Kopfhaut wirksam von Produktrückständen', second lather for heavy buildup); olefin-sulfonate chassis with light deposition is compatible. 'strukturiertes Haar'/curls is hair_texture.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: 'sanft', 'milde Rezeptur', 'nourish curls' care claims; cleansing only moderate
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Buildup role dominates name and claims; formula compatible -> clarifying.

focusSecondary.rationale: 'nourish curls', 'protect against breakage' are generic care over a nonspecific formula (F1); no independent route.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: buildup intent exists but cleansingStrength is moderate, so alternating is excluded (§9: a moderate formula is never alternating); no D1 lexicon term, no daily positioning.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C moderate). T2: 'strukturiertes Haar'/curls ignored. T4: W neighbor moderate would make fine acceptable -> review_thickness_boundary (fine); C neighbor low keeps coarse acceptable.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-ORDINARY: buildup removal from scalp is not an E2 scalp-condition claim.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular. I3: neighbor strong would give clarifying (alternating + clarifying focus), not the expected regular -> no flag.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D1 false: 'removes buildup' and 'second lather' are not D1 lexicon terms and directions do not limit use frequency.

uncertainties: §2 identity: the manufacturer source is English-language copy with a disclaimer that the INCI may vary by time and region; packet does not state the formula source tier. No concrete conflict shown, so properties kept at moderate rather than blocked.
C1 covers alkyl ether sulfates; olefin sulfonate + betaine is not covered. Applied by analogy (moderate, neighbor strong).

§7.1 clarifying 'buildup role with compatible architecture' with only moderate cleansing: standard does not define 'compatible'; usage then falls to regular and intensity to regular, so a clarifying-focus product shows no clarifying signal anywhere in the projection.
